name: ai-adoption-briefing
description: Translate a technical AI capability, system, or research result into a concise, decision-maker-ready briefing covering use case, operational value, risks, constraints, required maturity, and implementation sequence. Use for defense, government, or enterprise stakeholder communication. Triggers on: "brief this for stakeholders", "translate this for decision makers", "write an adoption briefing", "explain this to non-technical audience", "AI capability assessment", "make this briefing-ready", "stakeholder summary".
